title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18

ai_review.summary: Average soundboard source using Beyer M160s and Sony TC‑D5, but reviewers feel this version is not the correct one
ai_review.review: The lone review notes that this release was sourced from a soundboard feed captured on Beyer M160 tape machines and transferred via a Sony TC‑D5, referencing the Jim Wise mastering. While the technical chain suggests a decent soundboard recording, the reviewer claims the version is wrong, resulting in an overall mixed/average impression.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review with a 3‑star rating; no musical details to boost the score, and the comment that the version is wrong drags the overall impression down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded on Beyer M160 tape decks and transferred via Sony TC‑D5; reviewer suggests this may not be the correct version despite a decent signal chain.
